recall.define: Define nursery, incarnation, read version, snapshot pin and demand credit with exact lifetime events.
recall.distinguish: Distinguish cancellation, acknowledgment, completion and quiescence; distinguish atomic accesses from coherent transactions.
recall.apply: An old actor reply reaches reused storage, a cancelled operation is freed and a sequence reader dereferences a retired pointer. Identify the violated invariants and derive repairs.
